content:
此模组为 EMI 添加了以下功能：

方块与实体标签

允许模组包制作者/模组开发者添加自定义酿造与铁砧配方

（已支持 Additional Additions 的酿造和 Exciting Enchants 的长矛锻造）

配置：

标签：

你可以将 assets/<id>/block_item_mappings.json 和 assets/<id>/entity_item_mappings.json 添加到任何资源包中。这些文件描述了应使用哪个物品来表示该方块或实体。

实体示例：

[{ "entity": "minecraft:leash_knot",         "item": "minecraft:lead",          "name": "拴绳" },
  { "entity": "minecraft:tnt",                "item": "minecraft:tnt" },
  { "entity": "minecraft:falling_block",      "item": "minecraft:sand",          "name": "下落方块" }]

方块示例：

[{ "block": "minecraft:fire",             "item": "minecraft:flint_and_steel", "name": "火" },
  { "block": "minecraft:soul_fire",        "item": "minecraft:flint_and_steel", "name": "灵魂之火" }]

配方：

铁砧和酿造台的配方可以像正常配方一样添加到配方文件夹中。注意：这些配方不会添加实际的功能，它们仅用于在 EMI 中显示。

铁砧：

{
"type": "emijeicompat:anvil_display",
  "conditions": [
    {
      "type": "neoforge:mod_loaded",
      "modid": "excitingenchants"
    }
  ],
"left": {
"item": "excitingenchants:melleable_swordspear"
},
"right": {
"id": "minecraft:iron_ingot",
"count": 3
},
"output": {
"id": "excitingenchants:repaired_swordspear",
"count": 1
}
}

酿造：

{
  "type": "emijeicompat:brewing_display",
  "conditions": [
    {
      "type": "neoforge:mod_loaded",
      "modid": "additionaladditions"
    }
  ],
  "input": {
    "id": "minecraft:potion",
    "components":
    {
      "minecraft:potion_contents": {
        "potion": "minecraft:water"
      }
    }
  },
  "ingredient": {
    "item": "additionaladditions:frostleaf"
  },
  "output": {
    "id": "additionaladditions:blue_suspicious_dye",
    "count": 1
  }
}
